subject: Sweet potatoes
hook: SWEET POTATOES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Cultivated sweet potatoes are naturally occurring GMOs: their genome contains functional bacterial DNA transferred millennia ago, making them the first known naturally transgenic food crop.
angle_support: The genome of cultivated sweet potatoes contains sequences of DNA from Agrobacterium (sensu lato; specifically, one related to Rhizobium rhizogenes), with genes actively expressed by the plants.
These observations make sweet potatoes the first known example of a naturally transgenic food crop.
title: The Ancient Vegetable That Engineered Itself
description: Long before scientists created transgenics in modern labs, nature beat them to it. Research reveals that cultivated sweet potatoes naturally absorbed foreign genes from microbes thousands of years ago. Ancient farmers ended up breeding these modified plants into a global staple.
narration: SWEET POTATOES IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture an ancient, untouched root vegetable harvested straight from prehistoric soil. It was closer to a biotech experiment. Every farmed sweet potato is an authentic, naturally occurring GMO. Millennia ago, Agrobacterium microbes inserted functional foreign DNA directly into the plant’s wild ancestor. Those bacterial genes remain active today. When early Central and South American farmers selected the best roots, they unknowingly cultivated history's earliest confirmed naturally transgenic crop. We were eating genetically modified food thousands of years before modern laboratories even existed.
